blocks.title: Antivirus software
blocks.text: Antivirus software protects a computer from harmful programs such as spyware.
When you download a file, the antivirus checks it for hidden threats; a safe file opens normally, while a harmful one triggers an alert and is blocked.

blocks.prompt: Why must antivirus software be kept up to date?
blocks.explanation: New malware appears constantly; updates teach the antivirus to recognize the latest threats.

items: Antivirus scans files and blocks harmful programs; keep it updated.
